cause_quote: The async replay change added `assertPreparedCurrentTurn(initial, params.signal)`, which calls `validateSessionTranscriptContextVersion(scope, prepared.version)` and rejects a metadata append that advances the transcript sequence after selection.
user_saw: A saved request could fail to resume if another writer appended transcript metadata during preparation, forcing the user to resend it.
summary: The fix retries persisted-turn replay preparation once after a transcript change, preserving the selected user entry and generation and allowing only one consumption.
reasoning: The parent commit's replay path looked up the active user entry by ID, so a metadata-only append could leave the selected anchor valid. PR #153432 added a full transcript-version check that throws when the sequence advances, even if the selected user entry is unchanged. PR #181473 added a retry only at final consumption, leaving the initial preparation failure in place.
